text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, that was so close! I found myself 
sweating with anticipation too!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, please don't apologize. Lining up 
together was just a spur-of-the-moment 
idea anyway...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Tomachop-san is plenty charming on his 
own, so it's totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
